overview.question: What services does Imora offer?
overview.answer: Concierge and access control, security and CCTV, pool maintenance, cleaning and gardening, and building maintenance. All with our own team, never subcontracted.

conserjeria.question: What does the concierge service include?
conserjeria.answer: Reception, access control, mail distribution and resident assistance, with flexible hours from 6 to 24 hours depending on each building's needs.

seguridad.question: How does the security and CCTV service work?
seguridad.answer: We handle the project, installation and maintenance of video surveillance and access control systems, protecting your building or shopping centre end to end.

maintenance.question: Do you handle building maintenance?
maintenance.answer: Yes. Our own technical team covers plumbing, electrics, locksmithing and small works in common areas, with a fast response to faults.

coverage.question: Which areas do you work in?
coverage.answer: We serve businesses, homeowner communities, buildings, shopping centres and car parks in Madrid capital, Pozuelo de Alarcón, Alcorcón and nearby municipalities across its metropolitan area.

schedule.question: What concierge hours can I contract?
schedule.answer: Whatever your building needs: from 6 to 24 hours of service. We adapt the schedule to each community's reality, not the other way round.

availability.question: Do you offer support outside office hours?
availability.answer: Yes. In addition to office hours, we provide 24-hour emergency support, 365 days a year, for any incident that can't wait.

quote.question: How do I request a quote?
quote.answer: Fill in the contact form or call us directly. We carry out an on-site visit and assessment of your community or building, and prepare a fixed quote with a reply within 48 hours, with no obligation.

financing.question: Do you offer payment facilities?
financing.answer: Yes, we defer 40% of the first year's billing, spread across the following monthly payments, interest-free.

changeService.question: I want to extend or change my contracted service, who do I talk to?
changeService.answer: Our sales team, who will review your new needs with you and prepare an updated proposal. You can write to them directly from the contact page.

substitutions.question: What happens if a concierge or technician is absent or on leave?
substitutions.answer: We cover any absence with a guaranteed substitute at no extra cost, so the service is never interrupted.

quality.question: How do you monitor service quality?
quality.answer: Our inspection department visits every service on site on a regular basis, to check that what was agreed is being delivered and to spot improvements before they become incidents.

certifications.question: Are you certified?
certifications.answer: Yes, we hold ISO 9001 (quality management), ISO 14001 (environmental management), ISO 45001 (occupational health and safety) and ISO 27001 (information security) certifications.

existingClient.question: I'm already an Imora client, where do I get support?
existingClient.answer: Visit our support page to see the right channel for your query (incidents, sales or billing), or write directly to soporte@imora.es.

index.title: Everything your business, community or building needs, from a single provider
index.subtitle: Six specialised services for businesses, homeowner communities, buildings and shopping centres, coordinated by a single team.

concierge.title: Concierge and access control
concierge.summary: Reception, access control, mail handling and support for residents, staff or customers, with flexible schedules from 6 to 24 hours for communities, buildings, businesses and shopping centres.
concierge.description: A concierge is the first impression of your community, your building or your business, and the filter that keeps unauthorised people out. We select and train our own staff for residential lobbies, company premises and shopping-centre entrances, and cover sick leave and holidays without ever leaving the desk empty.
concierge.cta: Request concierge for my community, building or business

subservices.title: Reception and resident support
subservices.description: The concierge knows every resident by name and which suppliers each home has authorised. Anything they can't resolve on the spot gets logged in a daily report and reaches the property administrator that same day, not at month's end.

subservices.title: Access control
subservices.description: Every visit is logged with an entry time, and the concierge checks identity before letting in anyone they don't recognise. Couriers follow a specific protocol so as not to disturb residents at night.

subservices.title: Mail and parcels
subservices.description: Parcels that need a signature are kept in a marked area and residents are notified through whatever channel the community chooses: a note, WhatsApp or an app. Registered mail and official notices are always handled with proof of receipt.

subservices.title: Cover for sick leave and holidays
subservices.description: Before starting their shift, the substitute is briefed on the building's particulars: residents with special needs, regular suppliers, open incidents. The goal is for the change of person to go unnoticed by the community.

faq.question: How much does the concierge service cost?
faq.answer: It depends on the coverage hours (part-time or 24 hours) and the size of the building. We prepare a fixed quote after visiting the property, with no hidden fees.

faq.question: Can I switch concierge providers without issues?
faq.answer: Yes. We handle the transition with the current property administrator, and if the existing concierge wants to stay on, we consider bringing them onto Imora's team.

faq.question: What happens if the concierge gets sick?
faq.answer: We cover the absence with another professional of the same profile, at no extra cost and with no interruption to the service.

faq.question: Can I hire coverage for mornings only?
faq.answer: Yes, shifts are adapted to what each community needs: half-day, split shift or full 6-to-24-hour coverage.

security.title: Security and CCTV
security.summary: Design, installation and maintenance of video surveillance and access control systems to protect your community, building, business or shopping centre.
security.description: We design the security system around the actual access points of each community, building, business or shopping centre, install it, and maintain it so cameras and access controls are still working the day they're actually needed.
security.cta: Request a security assessment for my building or business

subservices.title: Video surveillance (CCTV)
subservices.description: Cameras go where the building's actual blind spots are (entrances, garage, common areas), not in a standard pattern. Footage is kept for a maximum of 30 days, following the Spanish data protection authority's general guidance on video surveillance.

subservices.title: Electronic access control
subservices.description: Each card or code is tied to a specific home and, if the community asks, to a specific time window. For example, to let an external cleaning crew in only during their contracted hours, with no one needing to open the door for them.

subservices.title: Equipment maintenance
subservices.description: We check cameras and recorders every quarter, and replace recording drives before they fail from wear. The goal is to catch the problem before the community realises it has gone weeks without recording anything.

subservices.title: Incident response
subservices.description: A technician reviews the report within 24 working hours. If the fault compromises the building's security, such as a downed access camera or a door that won't lock, it becomes an immediate priority.

faq.question: How long is footage kept?
faq.answer: A maximum of 30 days, following the Spanish data protection authority's general guidance, unless it's needed for an ongoing investigation.

faq.question: Who can view the recordings?
faq.answer: Only staff authorised by the community, usually the president and the property administrator, with restricted, logged access.

faq.question: Can the system be expanded later?
faq.answer: Yes, the project is designed so cameras or access-control points can be added later without replacing the whole system.

faq.question: What happens if a camera stops working?
faq.answer: The report is treated as a security incident, not routine maintenance: a technician reviews the fault within 24 working hours.

pools.title: Pool maintenance
pools.summary: Full pool service, with qualified lifeguards throughout the summer season, for homeowner communities, buildings and complexes with a swimming area.
pools.description: We handle the chemical maintenance and cleaning of the community pool, and provide qualified lifeguards throughout the swimming season so the community, building or complex can enjoy the pool fully up to code.
pools.cta: Get my pool ready for the season

subservices.title: Water chemical maintenance
subservices.description: We measure pH (target 7.2-7.6) and free chlorine (0.5-2 mg/l) daily, following Spanish health regulations for collective-use pools. Dosing is adjusted to that day's actual pool usage, not a fixed factory routine.

subservices.title: Cleaning the pool and deck
subservices.description: The pool floor and walls are brushed to prevent algae, and the deck area is cleaned daily during peak season, which is when it actually gets dirty. The goal is for it to actually be clean, not just look it.

subservices.title: Qualified lifeguards
subservices.description: Lifeguards hold a current official water-rescue qualification and cover the full swimming hours the community sets, with no unwatched gap at midday or on the last weekend of the season.

subservices.title: Season opening and closing
subservices.description: Before opening we check pumps, filters and the dosing system, and deep-clean after winter. When closing, we cover the pool and protect the equipment from humidity and cold so it reaches next season intact.

faq.question: When does the service run, from and to?
faq.answer: Usually from June to September, but we adjust the dates to the actual opening and closing calendar the community decides on.

faq.question: Do I need a lifeguard if the pool is small?
faq.answer: It depends on regional regulations and the pool's capacity; we advise you based on your community's specific case.

faq.question: What happens if the lifeguard is out for a day?
faq.answer: We cover the absence with another qualified lifeguard; the pool is never left unwatched during the contracted hours.

faq.question: Can I hire just the chemical maintenance, without a lifeguard?
faq.answer: Yes, water maintenance and lifeguarding can be contracted separately, depending on what the community already has covered.

cleaning.title: Complete cleaning
cleaning.summary: Cleaning of common areas, windows and garages so your community, building, business or shopping centre looks its best all year round.
cleaning.description: A fixed team takes care of cleaning the entrance, stairs, common areas and garage, at whatever frequency each community, building, business or shopping centre needs.

subservices.title: Cleaning common areas
subservices.description: The team follows a task plan by area (entrance, stairs, lift) so no corner gets skipped, at whatever frequency the community, building or business decides: from daily to twice a week.

subservices.title: Window cleaning
subservices.description: Entrance and common-area windows are part of the regular plan. Accessible façade cleaning with a pole is scheduled as an add-on depending on the building's height and access, not bundled by default in every case.

subservices.title: Garage cleaning
subservices.description: Sweeping and mopping the ramp, parking spaces and aisles, with specific treatment for oil and grease stains. Scheduled at whatever frequency the community's, building's or business's car park needs.

subservices.title: Supply of materials
subservices.description: Cleaning products meet current regulations, and Imora offers eco-friendly alternatives at no extra cost if the community prefers them. The community or business never has to buy or store products.

faq.question: How often is the building cleaned?
faq.answer: Whatever the community, building or business decides: from a weekly clean to a daily team, depending on the size and use of the property.

faq.question: Does it include cleaning inside private homes or offices?
faq.answer: No, the service covers common areas only: entrance, stairs, garage and shared outdoor areas.

faq.question: Can I request a one-off clean, not a recurring one?
faq.answer: Yes, for example after building work or before a community or business event, as an add-on to the regular plan.

faq.question: Is garage cleaning included?
faq.answer: It can be included in the general plan or hired as an add-on, depending on the condition and use of the garage or car park.

gardening.title: Gardening and green areas
gardening.summary: Design, upkeep and pruning of gardens and green areas for communities, buildings, businesses and shopping centres.
gardening.description: A gardening team experienced in communities and commercial spaces handles pruning, irrigation and the upkeep of lawns, hedges and green areas, with periodic visits or an annual plan depending on what each property or business needs.

subservices.title: Pruning and tree care
subservices.description: Pruning is planned around each plant's species and flowering season, not a fixed date for the whole garden. Pruning a tree or rose bush at the wrong time can cost you a whole year's blooms or growth.

subservices.title: Automatic irrigation and water control
subservices.description: We check and program automatic irrigation systems to match water use to the season, avoiding both plant water stress and unnecessary spending across common areas, outdoor car parks or business and shopping-centre entrances.

subservices.title: Lawns, hedges and ornamental areas
subservices.description: Mowing, hedge trimming and care of ornamental areas at whatever frequency the season sets, so the green areas of the community, building or shopping centre stay well kept all year round.

subservices.title: Green waste removal
subservices.description: Pruning, mowing and leaf waste is removed after every visit, so the garden area and vehicle or pedestrian access are never left cluttered with green waste.

faq.question: Can gardening be hired together with cleaning?
faq.answer: Yes, it can be hired together with the cleaning service or on its own, depending on what the community, building or business already has in place.

faq.question: How often is the upkeep carried out?
faq.answer: Whatever each community or business decides: from fortnightly visits to a weekly plan during peak season, when growth is highest.

faq.question: Do you service gardens for small communities as well as shopping centres or business parks?
faq.answer: Yes, we adapt the team and frequency to the real size of the green area, from a lobby garden to the outdoor areas of a shopping centre or business park.

faq.question: Does it include replacing plants that don't survive?
faq.answer: Replacing dead or damaged plants is quoted as an add-on service, since it depends on the species and the cause of the damage.

maintenance.title: Building maintenance
maintenance.summary: Plumbing, electrics, locksmithing and small works for communities, buildings, businesses and shopping centres, with an in-house technical team and fast response times.
maintenance.description: We resolve day-to-day maintenance issues across communities, buildings, businesses and shopping centres with our own technical team (not subcontracted), which lets us respond quickly to plumbing, electrical, locksmith or small building work issues.
maintenance.cta: Request technical maintenance for my community or business

subservices.title: Plumbing
subservices.description: Leaks and faults in common areas are handled with the tools the technician already carries, without waiting to source a part. More complex repairs get a quote before any work starts, with no surprises on the bill.

subservices.title: Electrics
subservices.description: We check the main distribution board and common-area lighting, and progressively swap old fittings for LED on request. The community sees the difference directly on its electricity bill.

subservices.title: Locksmithing
subservices.description: A locksmith problem on a common-area entrance is treated as urgent because it's a security issue, not routine maintenance that can wait until Monday.

subservices.title: Small works
subservices.description: One-off masonry, painting or carpentry repairs in common areas that many property administrators leave pending for months for lack of someone to call.

faq.question: How do I report a fault?
faq.answer: By phone, email, or through the building's concierge if you also have that service; the technician reviews the report within the agreed time.

faq.question: Are parts and materials included?
faq.answer: Labour is covered by the contracted plan; materials and replacement parts are quoted separately before any work starts.

faq.question: Do you handle emergencies outside office hours?
faq.answer: Yes, through the 24-hour emergency phone line for issues that can't wait until the next day.

faq.question: Can I hire just one type of maintenance, like electrics?
faq.answer: Yes, each area (plumbing, electrics, locksmithing, small works) can be contracted independently.
